test_title: PYST 48: SSC MTS - Quantitative Aptitude (Held on: 26 July 2022 Shift 3)
subject: maths
question: Find the smallest natural number ‘x’ that must be subtracted from 1800 so that (1800 - x), when divided by 7, 11 and 23, will leave 5 as the remainder in each case.
solution:
**Calculations:**

Step 1 - Take LCM (7, 11, 23) = 1771

Step 2 - Divide 1800 by 1771.

⇒ 1800 ÷ 1771 = 1 (quotient) and 29 (remainder)

Step 3 - To get 5 as remainder you must subtract 24.

⇒ 29 – 24 = 5

Result : 1800 – 24 = 1776

⇒ 1776 ÷ 7 = 253 (quotient) + 5 (remainder)

⇒ 1776 ÷ 11 = 161 (quotient) + 5 (remainder)

⇒ 1776 ÷ 23 = 77 (quotient) + 5 (remainder)

**∴ The smallest natural number ‘x’ must be 24.**
